rationale: Share vs isolate tables to force contention on same jobs/stats/versions tables vs separate tables in one schema; vary jobs 0/1/2 to exercise idle polling, single new->queued->active->terminal transition, and multi-job dequeue; vary poll_interval to change polling pressure while second actor connect/disconnect runs migrations. Targets lost updates, duplicate processing, enqueue dedup on key, and overwritten terminal statuses.
